source_notes: All values are read from Epoch AI's own Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) score table at https://epoch.ai/data/eci_scores.csv, retrieved 2026-09-07. That CSV is the data file the interactive leaderboard at https://epoch.ai/eci fetches at runtime; it is not linked from the page, and was located by reading the leaderboard's client bundle (/_astro/GenericBenchmarkChart.C9W1-9cX.js), which calls fetch('/data/eci_scores.csv'). The file has 267 model rows with columns Model, Display name, eci, eci_ci_low, eci_ci_high, date, Organization, Country, Model accessibility. The scale is anchored so Claude 3.5 Sonnet (2024-06-20) = 130.0 and GPT-5 (2025-08-07) = 150.0, matching the documentation at https://epoch.ai/data/eci-documentation. The newest row in the snapshot is GPT-6 Astra dated 2026-09-03, so the table was current as of the retrieval date. Eleven of the thirteen requested models appear by name; Gemini 3.8 Flash and Muse Spark 1.3 have no row, and each falls back to the immediately preceding release in the same family. No value here is interpolated, averaged, or estimated.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.note: Epoch date 2026-09-03; 95% CI 164.85-174.02. Highest score in the table and the newest row in it, so the CI is the widest of the set.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
